description: Write down a structural decision you made for one of the owner's SERVER apps (graduated), in plain text: why (context), what (decision), what follows (consequences) and when to revisit it (reexamen, at least 20 characters: a date or an event). These decisions join the app's runward mission in its proof dossier, after the four decisions of the kit, and runward checks them: a decision without a date, a status in its closed list or a reevaluation trigger is set aside. action='add' records one (status 'proposed' by default, or 'accepted'); action='list' (default) returns them; action='retire' marks one 'superseded' (never erased: the history of an app is not rewritten). At most 30 per app; title 120 characters, each section 2,000. Record a decision when you choose a data model, a link to another app, a security or privacy rule, or a trade-off the owner should remember. Then ask for a proof dossier (owner, in the cockpit) and read its verdict with dropyour_status. Owner only, with a connected account; refused for a simple page.

consequences.description: For add: what follows, good and bad.

contexte.description: For add: why a decision was needed.

id.description: For retire: the decision id, e.g. 'd002'.

reexamen.description: For add: when to revisit it, a date or an event (20 characters at least).

titre.description: For add: the decision in one line (120 characters at most).

name: dropyour_decision
title: Record a decision about one of my server apps
